'''Joan Verdú Sánchez'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Verdú|Sánchez}} (born 23 May 1995)<ref>{{cite web |url=http://data.fis-ski.com/dynamic/athlete-biography.html?sector=AL&competitorid=166175&type=result&rec_start=0&limit=100 |title=FIS bio |publisher=Data.fis-ski.com |date= |accessdate=2014-02-06}}</ref> is an Andorran [[FIS Alpine Ski World Cup|World Cup]] [[Alpine skiing|alpine ski racer]] who specializes in the technical events of [[Slalom skiing|slalom]], [[giant slalom]] and [[super-G]]. He made his ski racing debut in 2010.

On 22 January 2012, Verdú finished third at the French national championships. Later that season, he finished third for [[Alpine skiing at the 2012 Winter Youth Olympics – Boys' super-G|boys' super-G]] at [[2012 Winter Youth Olympics]]. He represented [[Andorra]] at the [[Andorra at the 2014 Winter Olympics|2014]],<ref>{{cite web |url=http://m.sochi2014.com/en/athlete-joan-verdu-sanchez |title=Sochi 2014 site |publisher=M.sochi2014.com |date= |accessdate=2014-02-06}}</ref><ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Joan Verdú |quote=Full name: Joan Verdú Sánchez}}</ref> [[Andorra at the 2018 Winter Olympics|2018]] and [[Andorra at the 2022 Winter Olympics|2022]] Winter Olympics.

On 9 December 2023, Verdú became the first Andorran ski racer to achieve a World Cup podium. He finished third on the giant slalom in [[Val-d'Isère]], France.<ref>{{cite news|title=Swiss star Odermatt wins World Cup giant slalom at Val d'Isere in French Alps|url=https://www.cbc.ca/sports/olympics/winter/alpine-skiing/alpine-skiing-world-cup-men-dec-9-recap-1.7054362|access-date=11 March 2022|work=[[Canadian Broadcasting Corporation|CBC]]|agency=[[Associated Press of Pakistan|AP]]|date=9 December 2023|quote=Joan Verdu, getting a best-ever World Cup result for the tiny principality of Andorra, was third trailing Odermatt by 1.32 seconds.}}</ref>

On 16 March 2024, he secured his second World Cup podium, finishing second in the giant slalom at the World Cup Finals in Saalbach, Austria.

==Personal life==
Since August 2022, Verdú is also a [[YouTube]] content creator, with a weekly vlog about his performances on the alpine skiing circuit.

He speaks Catalan, Spanish and English fluently.

Since 2025, he has been in a relationship with Spanish influencer [[Laura Escanes]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.infobae.com/espana/2025/02/22/joan-verdu-la-nueva-pareja-de-laura-escanes-y-exprofesor-de-risto-mejide/ |title=Joan Verdú, la nueva pareja de Laura Escanes... y exprofesor de Risto Mejide |date=22 February 2025 |access-date=12 January 2026 |newspaper=[[Infobae]] |language=es}}</ref>
